featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.

today.name: OFFICIAL LTR PINKTOBER CONVOY!
today.description:
## OFFICIAL LTR PINKTOBER CONVOY! 🌸
- Oficiální konvoj pro podporu léčby a prevence rakoviny prsu - Pinktober.
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/IaCWTde.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The CARGO is reccomended for flowers & medical equipment or vaccines.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **18:30** - Meet at the parking slots in TruckersMP HQ.
*  **19:00**  - Departure from TruckersMP large parking.
*  **19:20**  - Passage trough the city of Prague.
*  **20:00**  - Passage around the city of Sttutgart.
*  **20:40** - Arrival of the convoy to the Geneva.
*  **20:45** - Final group photo and end of the convoy.



![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/DOffoNx.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. TruckersMP HQ, Cargotras - Geneva, SellPlan.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*

# 🎃👻 Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy 2026 👻🎃

As darkness falls and ghostly figures begin to roam the roads, it's time for the **Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy**!

On October 31st, 2026, we invite you to join us for an unforgettable night filled with spooky vibes, impressive truck formations, and a strong sense of community. Together, we'll transform the roads of Euro Truck Simulator 2 into a haunting parade of lights, shadows, and Halloween spirit.

This convoy is all about bringing the community together. Whether you're part of a VTC, driving with friends, or joining on your own, everyone is welcome to take part in this spooky celebration.

### ***Important Information:***
* Registration is required.
* VTCs can book dedicated slots.
* Please provide an approximate participant count when booking a slot.
* Halloween-themed truck paint jobs and decorations are highly encouraged.

Let's make this Halloween night one to remember and show what the TruckersMP community is capable of when we come together.

We look forward to welcoming you to the Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy 2026!

🎃 Stay spooky and drive safe! 👻

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 🎃 ***Event Information***

* 📅 Date: October 31st, 2026
* 🕖 Meet-Up: 19:00 (Timezone: Europe/Amsterdam)
* 🚛 Departure: 20:00 (Timezone: Europe/Amsterdam)
* 📍 Starting Location: Duisburg (Slots)


### 🎟️ ***Registration***

* ⚠️ Registration is required.
* 🚚 VTCs can reserve dedicated slots.

### **Slot booking is open until October 28, 2026. Slot booking is now closed!**


### 👻 ***Halloween Theme***

* 🎨 Halloween-themed paint jobs aren't highly encouraged.
* 🕸️ Decorate your truck and embrace the spooky atmosphere.
* 🌙 Let's turn the roads of ETS2 into a haunting convoy experience.


### 📋 ***Convoy Rules***

* 🚫 No overtaking.

upcoming.description:
## EXPORT OF TURKISH FOODS TOWARDS EGYPT!
- Export tureckého Ayranu a kebabového masa do Egypta!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/DnJxu9A.jpeg)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The CARGO is restricted for the Chicken Meat or Yoghurt.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **19:00** - Meet at the parking slots in Mersin.
*  **19:30**  - Departure from the Mersin towards Silifke Ferry.
*  **19:45**  - Onobarding Ferry towards Lebanon. 
*  **19:50**  - Departure from the Ferry towards Lebanon Mountains.
*  **20:20** -  Passage around the Damascus City - Syria.
*  **21:10** - Arrival to the Taba - Arabian Food.
*  **21:15** - Exploration of viewpoint and end of the convoy.


![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/ffWyek5.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Mersin, Any Company - Taba, Arabian Food.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## ALL SLOTS - MERSIN

![](https://i.imgur.com/RuRbHEG.jpeg)


*If your company has less than 5 members or you are a member of our company, you do not need to reserve a slot.*


## [FOR RESERVATION OF SLOT VISIT OUR DISCORD!](https://discord.gg/gHnKQqYpHu)
